# Quranic Science (quranicscience.info)

> Quranic Science is an online Islamic educational platform by Arsalan Ahmed Shaikh. It explains the Quran's reflections on the natural world in Urdu and Hindi (with English and Arabic pages), and teaches live online courses: Tajweed, Arabic speaking, AI Masterclass (ChatGPT, Claude, AI images and video), video editing and content creation. Tagline: "Ilm Jo Soch Badal De" (Knowledge that changes the way you think).

Students learn in live Zoom classes with recordings, answer 3 questions after each class, rate their teacher, ask doubts to the teacher, and receive a verifiable certificate. Enrolment and class alerts work through WhatsApp (+91 78228 31751). Fees are in Indian rupees and payable online (UPI/card).

## Courses

- [All-in-One Creator Course](https://quranicscience.info/course-all-in-one-creator-course.html): AI Masterclass, Video Editing and Content Creation in one complete course, plus our Graphic Design course as a free gift. Everything you need to create, edit, design and grow, from zero to pro. Fee: ₹19999. 2 months, Live classes + recordings.
- [Tajweed + Arabic Combo](https://quranicscience.info/course-tajweed-arabic-combo.html): Learn to recite the Quran beautifully with Tajweed and understand it with spoken Arabic, together in one combo at a special price. Fee: ₹7499. 3 months (12 weeks), Live classes + recordings.
- [AI Masterclass](https://quranicscience.info/course-ai-masterclass.html): ChatGPT, Claude, AI video and AI design tools, taught for creators, students and small businesses. Recorded lessons you can watch anytime, at your own pace. Fee: ₹1499. Recorded lessons · watch anytime.
- [Video Editing Course](https://quranicscience.info/course-video-editing-course.html): Reels, shorts and YouTube edits: cuts, captions, colour, sound design and motion basics. Fee: ₹9999. 40 days, Live classes + recordings.
- [Content Creation: Zero to Pro](https://quranicscience.info/course-content-creation-zero-to-pro.html): Find your niche, script, shoot, edit and grow on Instagram and YouTube, step by step. Fee: ₹9999. 20 days, Live classes + recordings.
- [Tajweed Class](https://quranicscience.info/course-tajweed-class.html): Makharij, sifaat and the rules of recitation, with one-to-one correction from the teacher. Fee: ₹2100. 3 months (12 weeks), Live classes + recordings.
- [Arabic Speaking Class](https://quranicscience.info/course-arabic-speaking-class.html): Everyday spoken Arabic plus the grammar and vocabulary that open up the Quran. Fee: ₹6000. 3 months (12 weeks), Live classes + recordings.
